services.title: Frontend Development
services.description: My interest in frontend development started with curiosity about how websites are built with code. I enjoy creating things and solving problems through programming. I started with Vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, then moved on to frontend frameworks such as React and Vue.

services.title: Backend Experience
services.description: As I learned more about frontend development, I became interested in how the backend works behind the scenes. I started learning Node.js to understand how frontend and backend communicate. Later, I joined a government-funded coding bootcamp where I learned Java and more about backend development.

services.title: 3D Development Experience
services.description: As I became more interested in interactive web experiences, I started learning about 3D development. I learned Three.js through Bruno Simon's course (shout out to Bruno Simon what a great tutor) and explored the basics of creating and working with 3D scenes. I also learned the basic skills of Blender to create and edit 3D models.
